chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abd al-Rahman, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abi Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed, Ali عليه السلام performed eight circuits, then added six, then performed four rak'ahs, because if the matter is as we have described, then he prays two rak'ahs upon completing the two tawafs and proceeds to the sa'y. Then when he finishes his sa'y, he returns and prays two other rak'ahs. Thus he has acted upon both reports together, and that which indicates this is:

key_terms.السَّعْيِ: the ritual walking between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.الْخَبَرَيْنِ: the two reports or narrations being reconciled
key_terms.رَكَعَاتٍ: units of prayer performed after tawaf

ai.seo_question: What should be done if someone performs eight circuits in tawaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the legal ruling for one who performs eight circuits in tawaf and explains how the action of Imam Ali عليه السلام reconciles the reports on the matter. It indicates a jurisprudential method of combining narrations by completing an additional tawaf and performing the corresponding prayers in an ordered way before and after sa'y.
